question: Which smart bird is the main character of this story? 🦜
explanation: Awesome! The main character of the story is a wise, green parrot who makes very smart choices! 🦜
hint: It is a green bird that can talk.

question: What beautiful color are the parrot's feathers? 🟢
explanation: Great job! Parrots have beautiful, bright green feathers that help them hide in trees! 🟢
hint: It is the color of leaves and grass.

question: What does a wise parrot like to eat? 🍎
explanation: Super! Parrots love to eat healthy and delicious sweet fruits from the jungle! 🍎
hint: They grow on trees and are very healthy.

question: What color is the wise parrot's beak? 🔴
explanation: Fantastic! A parrot usually has a beautiful, curved red beak for eating! 🔴
hint: It is the color of an apple.

question: What does the word 'wise' mean in the story? 🧠
explanation: Brilliant! Being wise means you are smart and make really good choices! 🧠
hint: It means using your brain to think.

question: Who wanted to catch the birds in the jungle? 🧍‍♂️
explanation: Awesome! A hunter came into the jungle looking to catch the birds! 🧍‍♂️
hint: This person catches animals.

question: What did the hunter use to trap the birds? 🕸️
explanation: Great job! The hunter threw a big net to trap the poor birds! 🕸️
hint: It is made of ropes tied together.

question: Where did the hunter throw the grains to trick the birds? 🌱
explanation: Super! The hunter put the yummy grains on the ground to make the birds come down! 🌱
hint: It is the dirt or floor of the jungle.

question: What did the wise parrot tell his friends to do? 🛑
explanation: Fantastic! The wise parrot told his friends to be careful and think before they act! 🛑
hint: He wanted them to stay safe.

question: Did the young birds listen to the wise parrot at first? 🙉
explanation: Brilliant! The young birds were too hungry and did not listen to the smart advice! ❌
hint: They ignored his good words.

question: What happened to the birds when they ate the grains? 🪤
explanation: Awesome! The birds got caught in the net because they were too greedy! 🪤
hint: They could not fly away.

question: How did the birds feel when they were trapped? 😢
explanation: Great job! The birds felt very sad and scared when they lost their freedom! 😢
hint: They had tears in their eyes.

question: Who had a smart idea to save everyone? 🧠
explanation: Super! The wise parrot used his big brain to think of a great plan to escape! 🦜
hint: He is the smart leader.

question: What clever trick did the wise parrot teach the birds? 😴
explanation: Fantastic! The parrot said to act asleep so the hunter would let them go! 😴
hint: It means closing your eyes and staying still.

question: What did the hunter do when he saw the sleeping birds? 👐
explanation: Brilliant! The hunter opened the net because he thought the birds were already asleep! 👐
hint: He unlocked the trap.

question: What did the birds do when the net was open? 🕊️
explanation: Awesome! As soon as they were free, the birds quickly flew up into the safe sky! 🕊️
hint: They used their wings to escape.

question: How did the hunter feel when the birds flew away? 😲
explanation: Great job! The hunter was very surprised because the smart birds tricked him! 😲
hint: He could not believe his eyes.

question: A big group of birds flying together is called a... 🦅
explanation: Super! A group of birds that fly and live together is called a flock! 🦅
hint: It starts with the letter F.

question: Where is a bird's safe home located? 🌳
explanation: Fantastic! Birds build their cozy and safe homes high up in the tall trees! 🌳
hint: It has green leaves and branches.

question: What do we call a bird's home? 🪹
explanation: Brilliant! Birds use small twigs and leaves to build a lovely nest! 🪹
hint: It is a round bed made of sticks.

question: What do birds use to fly in the sky? 🪽
explanation: Awesome! Birds flap their strong wings to fly high up in the blue sky! 🪽
hint: They have beautiful feathers on them.

question: Which word is the opposite of 'foolish'? 🧠
explanation: Great job! Wise is the opposite of foolish, and it means being very smart! 🧠
hint: The parrot in the story is this.

question: How did the birds feel when they were finally free? 😊
explanation: Super! Freedom is wonderful, and the birds were so happy to fly again! 😊
hint: They had big smiles.

question: What is the best place for a bird to live? 🌴
explanation: Fantastic! Birds love to live in the free jungle where they can fly anywhere! 🌴
hint: A place with lots of trees and no walls.

question: What special thing can some parrots learn to do? 🗣️
explanation: Brilliant! Parrots are so smart that they can learn to talk and copy human words! 🗣️
hint: They use their voice to say hello.

question: What covers a bird's body to keep it warm? 🪶
explanation: Awesome! Birds have soft, colorful feathers that keep them warm and help them fly! 🪶
hint: They are light and fluffy.

question: What sweet sound does a small bird make? 🎵
explanation: Great job! Birds love to sing and make a happy 'chirp chirp' sound! 🎵
hint: It is a high, musical sound.

question: Which word rhymes with 'fly'? ☁️
explanation: Super! The words 'fly' and 'sky' sound the same at the end, so they rhyme! ☁️
hint: It is blue and above us.

question: What did the young birds say to the wise parrot at the end? 🙏
explanation: Fantastic! The birds said 'Thank you' because the wise parrot saved their lives! 🙏
hint: They showed him gratitude.

question: If someone gives you wise advice, what should you do? 👂
explanation: Brilliant! We should always listen nicely when older and smarter people give us advice! 👂
hint: Use your ears and pay attention.

question: What spicy vegetable do parrots love to eat? 🌶️
explanation: Awesome! Parrots really love to munch on spicy green chillies! 🌶️
hint: It is hot and spicy.

question: What do we call a cute baby bird? 🐥
explanation: Great job! A baby bird that hatches from an egg is called a chick! 🐥
hint: It is small, yellow, and says peep.

question: A wise choice always keeps us... 🛡️
explanation: Super! Making wise choices like the parrot helps us stay safe and happy! 🛡️
hint: It means free from harm.

question: When you are in a difficult problem, you should... 🤔
explanation: Fantastic! Just like the parrot, thinking calmly helps us solve any big problem! 🤔
hint: Use your brain quietly.

question: Helping your friends when they need it is very... 💖
explanation: Brilliant! The parrot was very kind to share his smart plan with his friends! 💖
hint: It means being nice and good.

question: What word is the opposite of 'trapped' or 'caught'? 🕊️
explanation: Awesome! Free is the best feeling for a bird to fly anywhere it wants! 🕊️
hint: It means having liberty to move.

question: What body part helps a parrot eat hard nuts? 🥜
explanation: Great job! Parrots use their strong, curved beak to easily crack open hard nuts! 🥜
hint: It is the bird's mouth.

question: The story of the Wise Parrot is a famous animal... 📖
explanation: Super! An animal story that teaches us a good lesson is called a tale or a fable! 📖
hint: It is a story you read.

question: To grab the tasty grains, the hungry birds flew... ⬇️
explanation: Fantastic! The birds saw the grains on the ground and quickly flew down to eat! ⬇️
hint: The opposite of up.

question: Because the birds were too greedy, they made a... ❌
explanation: Brilliant! Not listening to wise advice was a bad mistake, but they learned from it! ❌
hint: It is an error or a wrong choice.

question: After the hunter left, the jungle was... 🌴
explanation: Awesome! With the hunter gone, all the birds could enjoy their safe jungle home again! 🌴
hint: Out of danger.

question: The smart parrot uses his big... 🧠
explanation: Great job! The parrot uses his brain to think of clever and amazing ideas! 🧠
hint: It is inside your head.

question: What is the best way to solve a problem with friends? 🤝
explanation: Super! By acting asleep together, the birds used wonderful teamwork to escape! 🤝
hint: Working together as a group.

question: A parrot's eyes are very... ✨
explanation: Fantastic! Birds have very bright and sharp eyes to see things from far away! ✨
hint: They shine and look sharp.

question: What time of day do birds wake up and sing? 🌅
explanation: Brilliant! Birds love to wake up early in the beautiful morning to sing happy songs! 🌅
hint: When the sun first comes up.

question: Because the birds learned a lesson, they became... 🎓
explanation: Awesome! Making mistakes and learning from them makes everyone much wiser! 🎓
hint: Smarter than before.

question: What is the moral or lesson of this story? 🧠
explanation: Great job! The story teaches us to always think first and not be too greedy! 🧠
hint: Use your brain before doing something.

question: When birds flap their wings, they can fly very... ☁️
explanation: Super! Birds can fly very high up into the clouds where they are completely free! ☁️
hint: Up in the sky.

question: Listening to good advice brings us a lot of... 🥳
explanation: Fantastic! Good advice keeps us safe and fills our lives with joy and happiness! 🥳
hint: Another word for big happiness.

question: Which word describes the wise parrot perfectly? 🌟
explanation: Brilliant! The wise parrot was very clever and saved everyone with a brilliant plan! 🌟
hint: It is another word for smart.
